description: Gather information about trails in AWS CloudTrail.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: include_shadow_trails
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include shadow trails in the response. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: trail_names
parameters.description: Specifies a list of trail names, trail ARNs, or both, of the trails to describe. If an empty list is specified, information for the trail in the current region is returned. Default: []

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Note: These examples do not set authentication details, see the AWS Guide for details.

# Gather information about all trails
- amazon.aws.cloudtrail_info:

# Gather information about a particular trail
- amazon.aws.cloudtrail_info:
    trail_names:
      - arn:aws:cloudtrail:us-east-2:123456789012:trail/MyTrail

return_values.name: trail_list
return_values.description: List of trail objects. Each element consists of a dict with all the information related to that cloudtrail. Returned: always

return_values.name: cloud_watch_logs_log_group_arn
return_values.description: Specifies an ARN, that represents the log group to which CloudTrail logs will be delivered. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:sns:us-east-2:123456789012:Mylog"

return_values.name: cloud_watch_logs_role_arn
return_values.description: Specifies the role for the CloudWatch Logs endpoint to assume to write to a user’s log group. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:sns:us-east-2:123456789012:Mylog"

return_values.name: has_custom_event_selectors
return_values.description: Specifies if the trail has custom event selectors. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: has_insight_selectors
return_values.description: Specifies whether a trail has insight types specified in an InsightSelector list. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: home_region
return_values.description: The region in which the trail was created. Returned: success Sample: "us-east-1"

return_values.name: include_global_service_events
return_values.description: If True, AWS API calls from AWS global services such as IAM are included. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: is_logging
return_values.description: Whether the CloudTrail is currently logging AWS API calls. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: is_multi_region_trail
return_values.description: Specifies whether the trail exists only in one region or exists in all regions. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: is_organization_trail
return_values.description: Specifies whether the trail is an organization trail. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: kms_key_id
return_values.description: Specifies the KMS key ID that encrypts the logs delivered by CloudTrail. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:123456789012:key/12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"

return_values.name: latest_cloud_watch_logs_delivery_error
return_values.description: Displays any CloudWatch Logs error that CloudTrail encountered when attempting to deliver logs to CloudWatch Logs. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_cloud_watch_logs_delivery_time
return_values.description: Displays the most recent date and time when CloudTrail delivered logs to CloudWatch Logs. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_delivery_attempt_succeeded
return_values.description: Specifies the date and time that CloudTrail last successful attempt to deliver log files to an account’s Amazon S3 bucket. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_delivery_attempt_time
return_values.description: Specifies the date and time that CloudTrail last attempt to deliver log files to an account’s Amazon S3 bucket. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_delivery_error
return_values.description: Displays any Amazon S3 error that CloudTrail encountered when attempting to deliver log files to the designated bucket. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_delivery_time
return_values.description: Specifies the date and time that CloudTrail last delivered log files to an account’s Amazon S3 bucket. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_digest_delivery_error
return_values.description: Displays any Amazon S3 error that CloudTrail encountered when attempting to deliver a digest file to the designated bucket. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_digest_delivery_time
return_values.description: Specifies the date and time that CloudTrail last delivered a digest file to an account’s Amazon S3 bucket. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_notification_attempt_succeeded
return_values.description: Specifies the date and time that CloudTrail last successful attempt to deliver a notification. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_notification_attempt_time
return_values.description: Specifies the date and time that CloudTrail last attempt to deliver a notification. Returned: success

return_values.name: latest_notification_error
return_values.description: Displays any Amazon SNS error that CloudTrail encountered when attempting to send a notification. Returned: success

return_values.name: log_file_validation_enabled
return_values.description: Specifies whether log file validation is enabled. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the trail. Returned: success Sample: "MyTrail"

return_values.name: resource_id
return_values.description: Specifies the ARN of the resource. Returned: success

return_values.name: s3_bucket_name
return_values.description: Name of the Amazon S3 bucket into which CloudTrail delivers the trail files. Returned: success Sample: "aws-cloudtrail-logs-xxxx"

return_values.name: s3_key_prefix
return_values.description: Amazon S3 key prefix that comes after the name of the bucket that is designated for log file delivery. Returned: success Sample: "xxxx"

return_values.name: sns_topic_arn
return_values.description: ARN of the Amazon SNS topic that CloudTrail uses to send notifications when log files are delivered. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:sns:us-east-2:123456789012:MyTopic"

return_values.name: start_logging_time
return_values.description: Specifies the most recent date and time when CloudTrail started recording API calls for an AWS account. Returned: success

return_values.name: stop_logging_time
return_values.description: Specifies the most recent date and time when CloudTrail stopped recording API calls for an AWS account. Returned: success

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Any tags assigned to the cloudtrail. Returned: always Sample: {"my_tag_key": "my_tag_value"}

return_values.name: trail_arn
return_values.description: Specifies the ARN of the trail. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:cloudtrail:us-east-2:123456789012:trail/MyTrail"
